summary.en: Soft inflation data and strong PCE/ADP reports eased rate-hike fears, pushing Wall Street futures higher overnight. Focus remains on AI chip supply chains (Micron earnings catalyst) and broader tech sector positioning ahead of Fed speakers.
summary.zh: 软通胀数据和强劲的 PCE/ADP 报告缓解了加息担忧，推动美股期货隔夜走高。焦点集中在 AI 芯片供应链（美光业绩催化剂）和大盘科技板块在美联储发言前的大盘配置。

title.en: Soft PCE Inflation Data Eases Fed Rate Hike Fears; Markets Rally Overnight
title.zh: 软 PCE 通胀数据缓解美联储加息担忧；市场隔夜反弹

impact.en: Lower inflation expectations reduce rate hike bets, benefiting growth stocks and reducing Treasury yield pressure.
impact.zh: 较低的通胀预期降低加息押注，利好成长股并减轻美债收益率压力。

macroRisk.en: No - inflation cooling supports rate stability narrative
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 通胀降温支持利率稳定叙事

title.en: Micron (MU) in Focus as AI Memory Demand Persists; Earnings Anticipation
title.zh: 美光 (MU) 受关注，AI 内存需求持续；业绩预期升温

impact.en: Micron's AI memory product line benefits from strong demand in data centers and consumer devices.
impact.zh: 美光的 AI 内存产品线受益于数据中心和消费设备强劲需求。

macroRisk.zh: 否 - 板块特定供需动态

title.en: Boeing Rises, Moderna Slides in Premarket Trading Sessions
title.zh: 波音隔夜上涨，Moderna 下滑

impact.en: Sector divergence evident: aviation recovery optimism vs biotech valuation compression.
impact.zh: 板块分化明显：航空业复苏乐观情绪与生物科技估值压缩形成对比。

macroRisk.zh: 否 - 公司特定事件主导

title.en: ADP Employment Data Beats Expectations; Labor Market Resilience Supports Economic Growth Outlook
title.zh: ADP 就业数据超预期；劳动力市场韧性支持经济增长前景

impact.en: Strong job creation eases recession fears and supports growth-stock valuations.
impact.zh: 强劲就业创造缓解衰退担忧，支持成长股估值。

macroRisk.en: No - pro-growth signal outweighs inflationary concerns
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 利好增长信号压倒通胀担忧

title.en: Treasury Yields Edge Lower as Investors Price in Dovish Fed Stance Ahead of October FOMC
title.zh: 美债收益率小幅回落，投资者押注 10 月美联储会议偏鸽派

impact.en: Yield decline reduces cost-of-capital for growth stocks and boosts rate-sensitive sectors.
impact.zh: 收益率下降降低成长股资本成本并提振利率敏感板块。

macroRisk.en: No - yields below historical norms reduce systemic risk
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 收益率低于历史水平降低系统性风险

ai.en: AI chip sector strong on persistent demand; Micron catalyst amid memory supply tightness. NVIDIA, AMD, and related suppliers positioned for continued gains.
ai.zh: AI 芯片板块需求持续强劲；美光催化剂叠加内存供应紧张。NVIDIA、AMD 及相关供应商有望继续获益。

semiconductor.en: Semis benefit from AI tailwinds and PC recovery. Memory segment (Micron) particularly strong; logic/advanced packaging sectors steady.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体受益于 AI 顺风与 PC 复苏。内存板块（美光）尤为强劲；逻辑/先进封装板块企稳。

bigTech.en: Magnificent Seven stocks hold strength on cloud demand and AI monetization. Cloud services remain resilient amid enterprise IT spending.
bigTech.zh: 七巨头股票在云需求和 AI 变现中保持强势。企业服务 IT 支出强劲支撑云服务。

energy.en: Oil prices stable but below recent highs; OPEC+ production discipline provides floor. Renewable energy transition gains traction amid policy shifts.
energy.zh: 油价企稳但低于近期高点；OPEC+ 生产纪律提供底部支撑。能源转型因政策调整而加速。

ev.en: EV sector faces headwinds from higher rates and consumer sentiment softness. Traditional OEMs (Ford, GM) repositioning; pure-play EV makers under pressure.
ev.zh: 电动车板块面临利率上升和消费者情绪疲软逆风。传统车企重新配置；纯电动车企承压。

market.en: Broad market sentiment risk-on with tech leading breadth. Volume elevated on economic data flow; breadth improving as earnings season progresses.
market.zh: 大盘风险偏好回升，科技股领先广度。经济数据流动下成交量放大；随着财报季推进，广度改善。

preciousMetals.en: Gold holds near all-time highs on safe-haven demand and rate stability narrative. Silver follows industrial/commodity backdrop.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金在避险需求和利率稳定叙事下维持近历史新高。白银跟随工业/大宗商品背景。

oil.en: WTI/Brent in equilibrium; geopolitical tensions provide modest premium. Demand outlook stable but constrained by economic uncertainty.
oil.zh: WTI/布伦特油价平衡；地缘政治紧张提供适度溢价。需求前景稳定但受经济不确定性制约。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures +0.2%, Nasdaq futures +0.4%, Dow futures flat; tech-led rally expected at open
futures.zh: 标普 500 期货 +0.2%，纳指期货 +0.4%，道指期货持平；开盘科技股领涨

treasury10Y.en: ~3.75-3.80% expected; yield decline from soft PCE data supports lower-end range
treasury10Y.zh: 预期 3.75-3.80%；软 PCE 数据推动收益率处于区间低段

dxy.en: DXY around 97.5-98.0; dollar stability amid inflation data, EUR/USD range-bound
dxy.zh: 美元指数约 97.5-98.0；通胀数据下美元稳定，欧元/美元区间震荡

oil.en: WTI ~$63-65/bbl; Brent ~$67-69/bbl; OPEC+ cuts providing support
oil.zh: WTI 约$63-65/桶；布伦特约$67-69/桶；OPEC+减产提供支撑

keyRisk.en: Watch October FOMC meeting for rate decision; monitor inflation data release timing
keyRisk.zh: 关注 10 月美联储会议利率决议；注意通胀数据发布时间

note.en: Soft inflation + strong economy = balanced risk environment. Tech leading but avoid overconfidence on rate bets.
note.zh: 通胀放缓 + 经济强劲=平衡风险环境。科技股领先但不宜对利率押注过于自信。
